item.title: 【農業】 Engineering soil microbiomes for resistance
item.description: Soil microbial communities sustain key ecosystem services but are impacted by global change, including warming. Some agricultural soil microbiomes show resistance to perturbation and could be engineered to confer resistance to more fragile systems.

item.title: 【農業】 Agricultural soil microbiomes are structurally and functionally more resistant to warming than adjacent natural ecosystems
item.description: Using warming microcosms across 100 paired sites, a global meta-analysis and microbiome manipulation experiments, this study shows that agricultural microbiomes confer higher compositional and multifunctionality resistance to warming and can transfer this resistance to natural soils.

item.title: 【農業】 Homestead food production improves women’s dietary diversity in Bangladesh
item.description: Empirical evidence on the contribution of different pathways through which homestead food production programmes may improve women’s dietary diversity remains scarce. In Bangladesh, garden production and nutrition education were found to be critical.

item.title: 【農業】 Impact pathways of a homestead food production programme on women’s dietary diversity in Bangladesh
item.description: The contribution of homestead food production (HFP) to nutrition and dietary diversity is context-specific and involves multiple pathways. Using panel data on 2,612 women in 96 settlements in rural Bangladesh, this study identifies and measures the impact pathways of a 3-year HFP intervention.

【環境】 Social inequalities mediate temperature–child maltreatment associations in Africa
item.description: The link between temperature and child maltreatment in Africa remains unexplored. This study demonstrates a substantial association, particularly among socio-economically disadvantaged families, driven by behavioural changes, occupational exposure and reduced household resources.

item.title: 【環境】 Understanding and reducing the intention–behaviour gap in climate action
item.description: Climate-friendly intentions do not always translate into action. This Review synthesizes evidence on the intrapersonal, social and structural mechanisms underlying this gap and outlines interventions that offer actionable strategies to close it.

item.title: 【環境】 Increasing atmospheric dryness and storms accelerates biomass turnover in Amazonian forests
item.description: The carbon sink of tropical forests is in part constrained by biomass turnover. This study assesses aboveground biomass turnover in the Amazon and finds that convective storms are the main driver of spatial variation in turnover and future climate impacts will lead to accelerated biomass turnover.

item.title: 【環境】 Exporting environmental harm
item.description: Multinational investment is vital for African growth, yet it drives higher rates of forest loss than local industry. Researchers now suggest that home-country laws should hold global firms accountable for their environmental footprint abroad.

item.title: 【環境】 Enduring cultural legacies affect Euro-American wildlife values
item.description: Little is known about how values emerge, evolve and affect people’s relation with their natural environment. A study now sheds light on the influence of the institutions of European colonization on present-day values towards wildlife in the Americas.

item.description: Natural silk, mechanically strong and biodegradable, offers great potential for sustainable functional materials. Here the authors present a simple thermomechanical method for fabricating high-performance structural and optically active materials directly from silk fibres.
